display_name: 盲恢复多相执行源域一致性检查
description: 用同一源预检权重比较原始和多相计算的源 IQ 与冻结识别器决策，并比较两者各自六步预检权重。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7 FP32 TF32 off deterministic, source-only 112-record no-query, CPU frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 112 observations from 672 fixed legal source pilot: RX4/6 and RX8 x seven views x eight; no TX truth

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored source pilot; no full-target equivalence claim

permissions.claim_scope: Source no-query comparison using frozen F outputs; no TX truth, V, target IQ or target truth; no model updates

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen native and polyphase source-only six-step smoke checkpoints; load native checkpoint into both implementations for fixed-weight comparison
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Both smoke checkpoints have 64 legal L_s/U_s IDs x 3 views, no DURA/F/TX/V/target in G training; source pilot excludes source training IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source-only smoke weights from fixed legal paired IQ; F separately frozen for source no-query comparison
checkpoint.selection_rule: Compare both predetermined implementations and both source smoke checkpoints; no target or performance-based selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU7 >=8192 MiB free, fewer than 3 total compute apps and one this-task worker; preserve existing GPU3,5,6 jobs
execution.stop_rule: Stop this owner on checkpoint or source-role mismatch, nonfinite output, target access or output collision; preserve other work.

expected_artifacts: result.json with source per-view IQ NMSE and per-record better/worse counts; no trained model

metric_names: frozen reader logit maximum absolute difference
dimensions: same source checkpoint vs independent six-update smoke checkpoints
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: no truth scoring; frozen reader source predictions only

rows.method: Same fixed native checkpoint in native and polyphase execution, then each independent six-update checkpoint; IQ max error and frozen-reader decision mismatches
rows.purpose: 112 source-only records, no target or TX truth; no full-test identity claim
rows.seed_notes: Previously fixed source smoke seed 2026110903, source fit 2026110611 and order 2026110904; no training in this comparison.
rows.budget_ref: 112 source records in 14 cells; three fixed model forwards and frozen reader predictions, no ground target

notes: Source F weights and outputs read exclusively for separate no-query comparison, not training; no TX/V/target.
Same checkpoint execution comparison and two independently six-step-trained checkpoint comparison are distinct.
112 source observations do not establish full-target equivalence or identical 20-epoch training trajectories.
GPU-only forward timer has fixed order and no warmup; descriptive single-run timing, not steady-state or full pipeline benchmark.
